result.stdout:
xd-icon <icon.svg|icon.png> [options]

Makes the icons of an app from one drawing. Variants for the small sizes sit next to it, named after it:
app.24.svg draws the sizes up to 24 px, app.40.svg those up to 40, app.svg the others.

Options (none: --ico --icns --png):
  -o, --out <folder>     where to write (default: the folder of the icon)
  --ico                  <name>.ico for Windows (16 to 256 px)
  --icns                 <name>.icns for macOS (16 to 1024 px)
  --png [sizes]          <name>-<size>.png, e.g. --png 48,256,512 (default: 256,512), for Linux
  --maui <#RRGGBB>       appicon.svg (the background color) and appiconfg.svg for a MauiIcon
  -h, --help             this help
